title: Ratings and flat-rate service entries
summary: This topic combines review rating comments about the G70 with flat-rate service record fragments, so the examples do not form a single coherent customer issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car itself or frame a moderate numeric rating as still favorable despite comparison to another performance benchmark.

negative.summary: Negative feedback cites an early small failure that required a service center visit shortly after delivery.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are flat-rate or repair-order style entries that mention service terminology without clear customer sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes customer opinion text with dealership or repair-order fragments, which limits coherence.
Several examples are undetermined administrative text, so the available evidence for interpretable customer sentiment is limited.
One positive example includes critical wording about performance, but it is supplied as positive and is summarized according to its assigned sentiment.
